newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end slightly off as Wall St slides.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end slightly off as Wall St slides.

text.p: Brazilian shares gave back early gains to end slightly lower on Tuesday as the local market again moved in tandem with Wall Street, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 39 most active stocks fell 0.19 percent to close at 8,961 points. Market turnover totaled 748.1 million reais ($711.7 million).
"The bolsa opened up, but the Dow weakened and our market followed it," said a senior trader.
Benchmark Telebras closed off 0.57 percent at 104.6 reais.
Shares in Petrobras, the state oil company, rose 1.42 percent to 215 reais amid positive expectations over a vote in a lower house committee on a bill that would open up of the petroleum sector.

Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) showed further weakness, falling 1.99 percent to 27.15 reais by the close. Analysts said the decline in CVRD's share price was justified because expectations over the announcement of CVRD's base price and auction date had already been discounted.
